capabilities: Disable delete keys, cut, and undo while paper mode is on
Toggle paper mode from the command palette
Show paper mode status in the status bar
extras: The README names two companion plugins, Freewriting Cleanup and Freewriting Prompts, as pairing well with this one; the author accepts feedback via Discord or email and asks for support through Bandcamp music purchases.
intentEvidence: This is the plugin version of digital paper, a minimal web app that does the same thing.
motivation: The author kept deleting whatever they wrote as soon as they typed it and wanted to force a write-first, edit-later habit.
problem: Obsidian's easy editing encourages deleting and rewriting as you type, which can stall getting ideas down during freewriting.

summary: Delete-blocking plugin that disables backspace, delete, cut and undo so typed text stays put, like writing in pen.
